title: Curated Summer Fair Fireworks by MichiJung
author: MichiJung
sourceDescription: Professional fireworks and crowd reactions at a small-town summer fair in the lower rhine area, Germany. There are lots of families: a baby is crying, children and adults are talking, and the crowd reacts with general exclamations and cheers. Murmurs and reactions remain unrecognizable. Unedited field recording captured on a smartphone.
modifications: cut 0.15-6.15s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain -2.00 dB (peak -0.70 dBFS); 30 ms fades
